title: load_runtime_bank KeyError 'prompt'
evidence: line 105: item['prompt'] raises KeyError; dict has 'follow_up_prompt' not 'prompt'
recommended_fix: Replace item['prompt'] with item.get('follow_up_prompt') or item.get('front') or ''

title: Doctor card content: front=Finnish back=Finnish no English translation
evidence: All 11507 cards have prompt='potilas' answer='potilas' - identical Finnish words, no English gloss
recommended_fix: Add English translations to card answer field or switch to published materials with bilingual content
verification_steps: Inspect 20 doctor cards - front shows Finnish term, back shows English translation

title: Nurse card content: front=Finnish back=Finnish no English translation
evidence: All 7551 cards have same Finnish word in prompt and answer fields
recommended_fix: Add English translations to card answer field
verification_steps: Inspect 20 nurse cards - front shows Finnish term, back shows English translation

title: TTS provider not configured - silent failure
evidence: openai_api_key='' and google_tts_credentials_path=None causes _pick_provider_and_voice() to return (None,None) -> TTSRouterError -> 503
recommended_fix: Set OPENAI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_TTS_CREDENTIALS_PATH in production environment
verification_steps: GET /api/v1/voice/tts/health shows providers.openai or providers.google = ok

title: Roleplay finish_session response shape mismatch
evidence: Backend returns scores as {fluency:74} not {avgPhrasesCoverage:N}; missing transcriptAnnotated, summary, strongPhrases, difficultPhrases, grammarObservations, nextSteps, nextAction
recommended_fix: Align get_roleplay_review() return shape with RoleplayFinishResponse TypeScript type
verification_steps: Complete 5-turn roleplay call /finish - response includes transcriptAnnotated array and summary

title: No entitlement check on professional cards endpoint
evidence: start_runtime_session route has no require_feature call for domain=professional; any authenticated user can access doctor/nurse cards

title: No entitlement check on roleplay session start
evidence: start_roleplay_session_route accepts no auth header; all sessions use user_id=preview; no profession-based access control
recommended_fix: Add optional auth with require_feature for professional professions
verification_steps: Free user token + profession=doctor roleplay start -> 403

title: Grammar and phrase card mode returns 404 - content_type hardcoded
evidence: load_authority_cards hardcodes content_type='vocabulary_card'; _filtered_cards skips all cards when content_type=grammar_card
recommended_fix: Derive content_type from card type field or treat grammar/phrase requests as vocabulary fallback

title: Roleplay opening and reply text has ASCII-stripped Finnish characters
evidence: tanaan should be tänään; Selva should be Selvä; Minka should be Minkä; Hyva should be Hyvä; Ymmarran should be Ymmärrän
recommended_fix: Replace ASCII-stripped strings with proper Unicode Finnish
verification_steps: Start roleplay session - openingText contains tänään with proper ä

title: Roleplay replies are generic appointment-booking not profession-specific
evidence: All 5 turns return identical appointment-booking Finnish text regardless of profession doctor/nurse/practical_nurse
recommended_fix: Create profession-specific reply sets or integrate LLM for dynamic responses
verification_steps: Doctor roleplay turn returns patient consultation language not appointment booking

title: Published card materials never loaded by runtime
evidence: CARDS_DIR points to practice/data/cards/ not materials/cards/published/; 33 published JSON files with bilingual content quality scores never served
recommended_fix: Update CARDS_DIR to load from materials/cards/published/ and update schema parser
verification_steps: GET /cards/deck returns cards with content from published directory (check id prefix card.vocab.doctor)

title: Practical nurse missing words/a1_a2 in published materials
evidence: practical_nurse words/ directory has only b1_b2.json; doctor and nurse both have a1_a2.json in words/
recommended_fix: Create words/a1_a2.json for practical nurse with A1-A2 level vocabulary

title: Roleplay v2 sessions use hardcoded user_id=preview
evidence: All v2 sessions use user_id=preview; any caller can access any session by guessing session_id
recommended_fix: Accept optional auth token in v2 routes and use actual user_id if provided
verification_steps: Two different users start sessions; neither can access the other's session

title: personaName in start_session returns scenario title not persona name
recommended_fix: Use _SCENARIOS entry personaName field instead of scenario_meta title

title: Backend subscription_status does not return professions array
evidence: subscription_status() never returns professions[] field; frontend must derive from tier string which is fragile
recommended_fix: Add professions list to subscription_status() return value

title: TTS request endpoint has no authentication requirement
evidence: POST /api/v1/voice/tts/requests accepts optional auth but does not require it; unauthenticated callers can trigger billable TTS API calls
recommended_fix: Add authentication requirement to TTS endpoint
